title: Jury Forge
summary: Your own AI code-review team for GitHub — self-hosted, on your own Cloudflare account.
challenge: Give every pull request a full review without sending the repository, the code or the model keys to somebody else's server.
decisions: One deployable: the Worker serves the dashboard, takes the GitHub webhooks and runs the reviews
A Durable Object coordinates each review run, so the free tier still fits
Reviewer model bindings are AES-256-GCM encrypted with a master key held as a Worker secret
Every reviewer gets its own instructions, its own model and its own base URL
ownership: Designed and built the review pipeline and its dashboard end to end.

callouts.text: The pull request under review, with its changed-file count.
Three of the configured reviewers; each one carries its own instructions and model.
Findings arrive as inline comments on one consolidated review.
The run is started by the GitHub webhook, not by polling.
